summary: Kingston merchant and Yale graduate of 1884 whose daughters went to Vassar; John's 2nd cousin 4x removed.
bio:
Nelson George Pringle was born at Kingston, Luzerne Co., PA, on 5 April 1860, the only child of Alexander J. Pringle and Mary Price. He was educated at Wyoming Seminary and at Yale, where he graduated in the class of 1884. He became a merchant in Kingston, and by 1899 had been in business there for about fifteen years, living with his widowed mother.

On 3 January 1884 he married Sarah Adula Copeland, daughter of the Rev. Dr. David Copeland, president of Wyoming Seminary from 1872 to 1882, and Sarah Wheelock. Their daughters Elizabeth, born 14 January 1891, and Bertha, born 30 October 1893, graduated from Vassar in 1913 and 1916. He died in 1908. He is John's 2nd cousin 4 times removed, and his daughters are 3rd cousins 3 times removed.
